sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT *
FROM dbo.abonnes
WHERE modifie_le > '@{activity('old_watermark').output.firstRow.OldWatermark}'
  AND modifie_le <= '@{activity('new_watermark').output.firstRow.NewWatermark}';

@concat(
  'SELECT * FROM dbo.locations WHERE modifie_le >= DATEADD(day, -7, ''',
  formatDateTime(pipeline().parameters.trigger, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),
  ''') AND modifie_le < ''',
  formatDateTime(pipeline().parameters.trigger, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),
  ''''
)

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(modifie_le), '1900-01-01') AS NewWatermark
FROM dbo.abonnes;

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(modifie_le), '1900-01-01') AS NewWatermark
FROM dbo.locations;
